title: Invisible Wallet
tagline: Invisible Wallet uses Lit Protocol to enable secure, keyless crypto transactions with seamless encryption and signing. No private keys, no hassle—just send crypto effortlessly. However, an error in transaction execution prevented completion. 🚀 #Web3 #DeFi #LitProtocol
description: Invisible Wallet is a decentralized transaction system built using Lit Protocol to enable seamless peer-to-peer cryptocurrency transfers without requiring users to manage private keys manually. By leveraging threshold cryptography and Lit Actions, the project aimed to provide a secure, gasless, and user-friendly experience where transactions could be sent effortlessly to friends. However, I was unable to complete it due to an error that prevented the transaction execution. The issue likely stemmed from encryption failures, transaction relay problems, or API response delays, which blocked the signing and broadcasting process. Despite troubleshooting, the error persisted, and I was unable to proceed further.
how_its_made: The Invisible Wallet is built using Next.js for the frontend and Lit Protocol for decentralized key management and secure transaction signing. It leverages LitNodeClient to establish a connection with the datil-test network, enabling encryption, decryption, and seamless authentication without requiring users to manage private keys manually. The project aimed to execute Ethereum transactions using Lit Actions, providing a gasless and user-friendly experience. However, I was unable to complete it due to an error during transaction execution, possibly caused by decryption issues, incorrect smart contract interaction, or network/API delays, preventing the signing and broadcasting of transactions.
